newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam to sell 50 bln dong T-notes on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam to sell 50 bln dong T-notes on Wednesday.

text.p: Vietnam will auction 50 billion dong ($4.29 million) worth of one-year Treasury notes on Wednesday, an official at the State Bank of Vietnam said on Tuesday.
At the last sale of government paper, on March 12, the central bank issued 38 billion dong worth of one-year Treasury notes to domestic institutions at an annual coupon of 11.60 percent.
There have been four Treasury paper auctions so far this year, through which a total of 128.4 billion dong worth of treasury stock has been issued. (US$1 = 11,650 dong)
